title: Using Icons-and-Text Task Manager and "Fit Content" setting on a panel causes it to jitter and uncenter itself when apps are opened or closed.
line: A centred Fit Content panel now grows and shrinks in place when apps open or close, instead of jumping off centre first.
explanation: When a layer-shell surface such as a panel changed size, KWin moved it to its new position immediately but kept showing the old-sized buffer until the client redrew. For a centred Fit Content panel that meant it was shown shifted left on every open and shifted right on every close, until plasmashell committed the new size; Qt acknowledges the new size before it has redrawn, so this lasted several frames. KWin now remembers the position that belongs to each requested size and moves the surface only on the commit that carries that size, so position and size change together.

commits.message:
layershellv1window: move resized surfaces with their new size

A layer surface that changed size was moved to its new position at once
while still showing its old size, so a centred panel jumped off centre.
Move it only when the client commits a buffer with the new size instead.

BUG: 518384

media.caption: Master, bottom panel Fit Content + centred with Icons-and-Text Task Manager. Rows: resting; while Konsole opens (panel shifted left, old width); Konsole open; just after closing (panel shifted right, empty gap).
With the fix, same steps. Rows: resting; first frame after Konsole opens (already centred at the new width); last frame with Konsole; first frame after closing (centred at the old width).
Master: Konsole opened and closed 3 times; the panel jumps sideways before every resize.
With the fix, same steps: one centred resize each time.

review.text: Deferring position updates for resized LayerShellV1Window surfaces until commit instead of moving synchronously in moveResizeInternal is a strong KWin-level root-cause fix for the off-centre jump. However, gating the move in handleCommitted() on an exact size equality check (m_acknowledgedConfigureEvent->size == clientSize()) is a brittle workaround for layer-shell-qt acknowledging configures prematurely and breaks valid wlr-layer-shell-v1 surfaces with 0-sized configures or rounded/mismatched buffer sizes; the patch also causes double updateGeometry() calls per resize and lacks autotests.
changes: Do not require m_acknowledgedConfigureEvent->size == clientSize() to apply the configured position in LayerShellV1Window::handleCommitted(): that leaves surfaces with client-chosen (0) configure dimensions or fractional-scaling/constraint size mismatches permanently stuck at (0, 0) on initial map or at their stale position on resize.

Fix layer-shell-qt to defer ack_configure until the resized buffer is actually committed (matching xdg-shell behavior) instead of working around premature acks with an exact-size check in KWin, and handle pending/acknowledged configure position updates in KWin safely when configure size is 0 or differs from clientSize().

Consolidate geometry updates into a single atomic updateGeometry() call in handleCommitted() instead of updating to (oldPos, newSize) in handleSizeChanged() and then immediately to (newPos, newSize) in handleCommitted().

Add autotests in testLayerShellV1Window covering deferred move-on-commit, 0-dimension configures, and size-mismatch/fractional-scale cases, and check whether the remaining 2-frame plasmashell content squish/gap in after-2.mp4 also needs a companion fix to fully resolve the reported jitter.
